newsitem.title: USA: Oglebay Norton acquires Kurtz Bros unit.
newsitem.headline: Oglebay Norton acquires Kurtz Bros unit.

text.p: The Industrial Sands Group of Oglebay Norton Co said on Tuesday that it had recently acquired the Sports Turf Division of Kurtz Bros Inc.
Oglebay did not disclosed a dollar amount for the transaction and no one was immediately available at the company to comment on the acquisition.
In a press release, Oglebay said it will continue to operate the division as a separate business unit under the name Kurtz Sports Turf Services for the time being.
Kurtz Sports Turf is a supplier of sand and organic blended materials used in golf courses and other recreation facilities.

"This acquisition is important to our continuing focus on sand-related businesses as sand is a substantial component of many of the blended products sold by Kurtz Sports Turf," said R. Thomas Green, Jr., president and chief executive officer of Oglebay.
Oglebay Norton Co is a Cleveland-based company engaged in Great Lakes marine transportation, the mining and marketing of industrial sands, and the manufacture of metallurgical products.
